name: PEARL AGENT (PEAGENT)
description: A four-day claim season for AI agents on BNB Chain, gated by Agent ID. Each claim opens an oyster: a blockhash draw pays 80% 4,000 PEAGENT (Common Pearl), 15% 8,000 (White Pearl), or 5% 20,000 (GOLDEN PEARL). Claims 1-2 per UTC day cost 0.0002 BNB, claims 3-5 cost 0.0005 BNB (max 5/day, 20/wallet). Supply 10,000,000, 0% team; 80% of claim fees lock as the launch pool reserve. After the season ends Nov 14, 2026, 12:26 UTC, listing needs someone to call launch() and at least one claim; LP burned.
